text:
alex: Quick question about the chat/completions streaming contract — specifically how we should represent optional function_call args and the ordering of delta events. Should an empty args object be sent as `null`, `{}`, or omitted entirely when there are no args? And do we guarantee that the `function_call` start delta always arrives before any arg deltas?

maria: Short answer: prefer omit. Sending `null` vs `{}` causes a few SDKs to deserialize differently. If there are no args, omit the `args` field.

sam: Does omitting break older clients that expect the field to exist? We still need backward compatibility for some internal SDKs.

maria: Good point — we have two concerns: 1) existing clients that looked for `args` and assume `{}` and 2) streaming reassembly logic that expects the sequence. For compatibility, recommend: if a client is older and expects `args` always, we should document that `args` may be absent and add a lint rule in the SDKs to map missing -> `{}`. That keeps wire cleaner.

jin: Can we define the exact delta ordering in the API doc? e.g. the sequence when invoking a function:
```json
{ "type": "function_call_start", "name": "search" }
{ "type": "function_call_arg_delta", "chunk": "{\"q\":\"foo\"}" }
{ "type": "function_call_end" }
```
So consumers can reassemble without guessing.

maria: Yes — define a simple state machine in the docs: start -> zero-or-more arg deltas -> end. The start event may include `name` and other metadata; args are optional and can be omitted. If the function call has no args, you can send start then end immediately (no arg deltas).

alex: For streaming clients that reconstruct tokens, do we promise ordering between regular message deltas and function_call fragments? E.g., can we interleave them?

maria: We should avoid interleaving in the same top-level chunk for now. Rule: deltas for the same logical role (assistant content vs function_call) should be emitted in contiguous sequence segments. Cross-interleaving is allowed only when the model intentionally switches roles mid-generation (rare). Document this as "contiguous fragments per role/action".

sam: SDK action items: 1) update JS/TS SDK to collapse missing `args` -> `{}`; 2) update Python SDK to treat `null`/missing similarly; 3) add tests for reassembly ordering. Anyone want to take 1 & 2?

jin: I'll grab the TS change, add a small test that simulates start+end with no args.

maria: I'll update the API doc PR with the state machine diagram and the explicit rules around omission vs null, plus a small example of streaming events. Will ping once ready.

deploy-bot: CI: docs/pr-321 failed lint (api/streaming.md) — missing streaming examples. See https://ci.internal/reports/321

alex: OK thanks. maria, can you include the minimal examples that fix the lint? If not, ping me and I can add them.

maria: Will do today. Also adding a note to the changelog about the SDK mapping behavior so integrators know what to expect.

sam: tl;dr: omit `args` when empty, SDKs map missing/null -> `{}`, define contiguous fragment ordering in docs, add tests. All good? :thumbsup:

alex: Yep. Thanks all.
